metadata.description: Every Claude tool of the owner in one catalog: the spec-driven development workflow (OpenSpec cycle, specialised agents, review, git guardrails, CI), standalone skills and desktop mods.

plugins.name: sdd-core
plugins.description: /sdd-init (reverse-documents a project and installs the workflow), review-harness, retro, domain-modeling, codebase-design, improve-codebase-architecture

plugins.name: sdd-ui
plugins.description: Optional UI skills: web-design-guidelines, break-ui, emil-design-eng, animate, review-animations, improve-animations

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: /handoff:handoff: handoff document to resume work in a fresh session, in any project

plugins.name: grilling
plugins.description: /grilling:grill-me and the grilling skill: the agent interviews you in rounds over a plan's decisions, with its recommended answer for each, before anything is built; in any project

plugins.name: wayfinder
plugins.description: /wayfinder:wayfinder: plan an effort bigger than one session as a map of decision tickets (GitHub issues or docs/wayfinder/), resolved one per session; in an sdd-core project it ends in a list of changes ready for /opsx:new

plugins.name: local-qa
plugins.description: /local-qa:qa-prepare: local QA environment for a change on a machine shared by parallel projects and agents (reuses what is compatible, starts the rest on free ports, stops only what it started), and the owner's QA brief

plugins.name: openspec-cockpit
plugins.description: Desktop app only: OpenSpec cockpit pane (next action, cycle timeline, task groups, decisions), gate alerts, status line. Pairs with the `cockpit` option of sdd-init.

plugins.name: conversation-cards
plugins.description: Desktop app only: Claude's messages as cards (questions, reports, QA, commits, cockpit block) and the display contract.

plugins.name: session-hud
plugins.description: Desktop app only: session band above the prompt (context, cost or rate limit, time, tools, model, background count).

plugins.name: background-tasks
plugins.description: Desktop app only: background pane listing services with their port and workflow runs with phases and agents.
